# name: # Cases over Tests.Resource.freezeProgram (Rust: freeze_program): Box is an
# addressed block, so plain data; freezing, fresh constructors, borrowing.
a unique plain value may be shared as its last use
a frozen value cannot be used again
a frozen value cannot be moved as unique
a unique value of an abstract type is not frozen
a fresh constructor result is unique
a fresh nullary constructor is unique
a constructor as a function value is not fresh
# Literals and closed constructions are static data, shared (strict setting
# S1); a construction is fresh only through a run-time local.
a literal is shared, not fresh
a string literal is shared, not fresh
a literal fills a shared position
a closed constructor application is static, not fresh
a field computed from a run-time local makes a construction fresh
a one-field constructor of a type without a known block is not fresh
a plain-data owner may be borrowed
a borrowed plain-data owner cannot move during the loan
